column1: # D13, D17. Sites for the human review. Coordinates are on the final scaffolds, in bp, 1-based.
# note: what is open, the evidence with its numbers, and the option you would offer the user.

column4: Placed at the user's D13 choice ("Place it again."): chain0182 (telomere) -> chain0135 -> connector chain8011 -> chain0101-, 1.19 Mb before the old start (bp 1193862 is the old bp 1). Start telomere now present; chr5_h2 still 3.6 Mb (7%) shorter than its longest homolog. Reads span every junction (14-31 reads within 2 kb), but the joins from 0.84 to 1.54 Mb have no q20 read: chain0135 is near-identical to the chr5 block at chr7_h1 0-0.96 Mb, so its placement rests on the graph path alone, not on unique reads. Check the start in Juicebox; if Hi-C disagrees, unplace chain0135 and chain0182.

Hi-C gap chain0141/next. Right edge: 2 of 2 q20 corrected and raw read tails enter unplaced chain0209 (147 kb, 7.5x total, 1.0x unique, no genes), which is also the D16 tail on chain0141-. chain0209's other end links chain0244 on a chr4_h1 tip path (7 kb overlap). Option was to place it as a tail; the user chose at D13: "Leave it unplaced." (Re-tested on the rebuild: scaffold unchanged, same coordinates.)

Hi-C gap chain0017/chain0122. chain0122 (1.47 Mb, repeat fraction 0.59, 21.8x, telomere at its far end) has no graph link, position_llr 502; it gives chr7_h1 its end telomere. chain0124 (1.45 Mb, same kind) was ordered beside it and left unplaced by the builder (hic_not_decisive, orientation_llr 25): 137 Hi-C links to chr7_h1, 14 at most elsewhere. Check this end in Juicebox. (Re-tested on the rebuild: scaffold unchanged, same coordinates.)

Translocation breakpoint (chr5 sequence from here to 40.69 Mb) at a Hi-C-only gap: no spanning read, right flank 134 Hi-C self pairs. Medium SV call; homologs (chr5_h1, chr5_h2) support the content. Check the junction in Juicebox. (Re-tested on the rebuild: scaffold unchanged, same coordinates.)

Haplotype-specific 11.1 Mb inversion, medium: left edge inside utg000576l with 24 q20 reads, right edge in repeat (not testable); Hi-C near/far at the left end 14:49. Check orientation in Juicebox. (Re-tested on the rebuild: scaffold unchanged, same coordinates.)

Translocation breakpoint (chr5 sequence to the end): 9 q20 spanners, but Hi-C cross ratio 0.051 against 0.164 background, the lowest tested. The end carries the D07 tip chain0221 (graph only, 91 kb overlap, low confidence). (Re-tested on the rebuild: scaffold unchanged, same coordinates.)

End has no telomere (chr6_h3's neither). Unplaced tangle of 31 chains, 8.26 Mb, touches only chr6_h2 by graph; Hi-C spread thinly (chain0147 carries 118 of 156 links). Not placed: no order inside a tangle. (Re-tested on the rebuild: scaffold unchanged, same coordinates.)

Satellite stack region with 3 gaps (25.55, 28.72, 35.52 Mb); chr8_h1 48.16 Mb against 39.12 and 34.16. The stack is placed by graph bridges, as in the old build; check it in Juicebox. (Re-tested on the rebuild: scaffold unchanged, same coordinates.)
Five gaps, the most of any scaffold, and no start telomere; 0-7.81 Mb is the chr4 translocated block. (Re-tested on the rebuild: scaffold unchanged, same coordinates.)

Gap inside the chr2 translocated block; 10 q20 read tails at the left edge spread over chr2 homologs, chr3_h1 itself and unplaced chain0181 (repeat anchoring). (Re-tested on the rebuild: scaffold unchanged, same coordinates.)

local_realign_failed: reads stop matching the left flank a median 10.3 kb before the gap; 4 q20 tails go to chr7_h1. Possible misassembly in the last 10 kb of the left flank. (Re-tested on the rebuild: scaffold unchanged, same coordinates.)
